command.info: View a tag's information and raw content
command.list_user: List all of a user's tags
command.remove_all: Remove all of the server's tags, with filters
command.export: Export tags from the server, with filters
command.import: Import tags from a NotSoBot or UglyTags export file
option.name: Tag's name
option.content: Tag's content (leave empty to open a form with multi-line text and files)
option.filter_user: Only tags made by this user
modal.content_placeholder: Text and TagScript, for example: Hello {{user}}!
modal.files_hint: Uploaded files are stored with the tag and added as {{attach:filename}}.
create.conflict_own: You already have a tag named {name}. Overwrite it, or create the new tag as {suggestion}?
create.conflict_other: Tag {name} already exists in this server and belongs to someone else. Create the new tag as {suggestion} instead?
create.expired: Request expired, run the command again.
result.alias: Ok, created an alias tag called {name} for tag {target}
info.title: Information
remove.expired: Request expired, press a button next time
remove_all.timeout: Canceled removing of {count} tags due to timeout. {scope}
scope.server: (Out of all of this server's tags)
import.done: Imported {imported} tags. Skipped {skipped} because a tag with that name or alias target was missing or already exists, and {invalid} invalid tags. {failed} attachment links could not be downloaded and were left as links.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
error.permissions: You do not have permission to do that.
error.owner: Only the person who started this can use these controls.
error.tag_exists: Tag already exists in this server!
error.tag_changed: That tag changed while you were editing it. Please try again.
error.not_owner: You're not the owner of this tag!
error.alias_not_owner: Tag already exists in this server and you do not own it!
error.alias_regular: Cannot edit a regular tag to be an alias tag.
error.name: Tag names must be between 1 and {limit} characters.
error.empty_content: Must have some sort of content for the tag!
error.content_length: Tag content cannot be longer than {limit} characters.
error.file_count: A tag can store at most {limit} files.
error.missing_files: These files are not stored on this tag: {files}
error.media_size: Each file must be between 1 byte and {max_media_mb} MB.
error.no_matching_tags: This server has no tags matching the search options.
error.remove_others: Not enough permissions to force remove other people's tags!
error.export_others: Not enough permissions to export other people's tags!
error.export_size: The export is larger than this server's upload limit. Use the name, content, or user filters to export fewer tags.
error.import_size: Import files can be at most 50 MB.
error.import_json: That file is not a valid tag export.
error.too_large: The tag's files are larger than this server's upload limit.
